name: Captain Kyrillos
description: Captain of a ten-man Alamon squad who leads it into One-Eyed Pass and dies killing the minotaur leader.

description_citations.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Ten soldiers of the Alamon wait at the Horns for Eumalos's squad, and Captain Kyrillos sends Bardas and Borias to climb the stones.
timeline.quote: Bardas, Borias—climb the Horns and see what you can see.

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Nikasios notices the cyclops's other leg was mauled rather than cut, and Kyrillos decides to investigate One-Eyed Pass since Eumalos's squad missed the rendezvous.
timeline.quote: there's something besides our soldiers in One-Eyed Pass that can drive off a cyclops. We're going to check it out.

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Boulders fall behind the squad, sealing the canyon, and a minotaur horde led by a huge sword-wielding brute charges them.
timeline.quote: From ahead of them came the sound of savage cries and thundering hooves, and then the first minotaurs rounded the corner.

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kyrillos rams his sword into the minotaur leader's gut, is slammed down and stomped, and the leader is beheaded by Pallas and Leandros, its body falling on Kyrillos, who dies.
timeline.quote: Pallas's sword made a great arc and severed the minotaur's head.

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.
